title: Version the scoring rules so old scores still verify; gate rule changes
summary: Goal: PR #129's provisional-cost rule must pass `athena check --history` without editing any record, and future scoring-rule changes must be checked against full history before landing. Read as: bump the rules version (v1→v2) so bound-only costs score provisional only under v2, keep recomputing v1 scores under v1 behavior, and add a mechanism that runs the history score check when scoring code changes. Audience: maintainers and CI.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for both rule versions and the new check; cargo test and clippy must pass.
The history check on rule changes is enforced by a test or xtask step.
Fix by rule versioning rather than exempting the 8 files.
Criteria run tests and the history check.
Decision recorded with alternatives in docs/decisions.md.
One focused change around scoring rule versioning.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: PR #129's code is already in the working tree (provisional field and cost_is_only_a_bound exist in athena-score), so this change builds on it.

The gate already checks `score.rules == RULES` and recomputes the score; the cleanest fix is a known-rules list with legacy behavior for v1, not a [history] exempt entry (which would hide the problem).
The 'before it lands' mechanism can be a test or xtask ci step that runs the history score recompute, since CI's history job already exists but ran only after the change was written.
Exact file paths beyond athena-score and athena-gate/jobs.rs are inferred.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new scorer test shows the same job records score with a bound-only cost provisional under the current rules string and not provisional under the previous v1 rules string; run `cargo test -p athena-score`.

A gate test shows a score file stamped with the v1 rules string, whose cost was a bound, still passes the score-follows-records check, and a v2 score with the wrong provisional flag is still rejected; run `cargo test -p athena-gate`.

`cargo run -p athena -- check --history` (or the repository's equivalent) over the repository reports no violation for the 8 existing score files, including records/jobs/2026-10/20261013-141005-hrdp/score.json, and no file under records/ is modified in the diff.
New scores are written under a bumped rules string (v2); the gate recomputes each score under the rules string it carries and still refuses an unknown rules string.

A mechanism, not prose, makes a change to scoring behavior get checked against the full history before landing: a test or the xtask ci step recomputes every historical score with the working-tree scorer and fails if the rules string was not bumped; run `cargo run -p xtask -- ci` or `cargo test` to see it pass, and a test shows it fails when a rule changes under an unchanged version.
`cargo test` passes, `cargo clippy` is clean, and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
The call (versioned rules over rewriting history or exempting records) is recorded with alternatives in docs/decisions.md.

out_of_scope: Editing or regenerating any file under records/
Showing provisional status in the status display (athena-cli display.rs)
Changing the kill-switch outcome logic from job 60r4
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass odds than reference: the change spans scorer, gate and a new check mechanism, and the history check needs cold builds.
